function: Deep Gaussian process maps received pilots to direct and cascaded channel estimates in a LIS-assisted mmWave massive MIMO downlink, plus an uncertainty measure (pp. 1-3).
system: Downlink: BS with 64 antennas, 8 single-antenna users, passive reflecting LIS with 100 elements, narrow-band flat fading, 60 GHz carrier, 40 MHz bandwidth (pp. 2, 4).
method: Deep Gaussian process regression (2 layers, 256 and 64 units, RBF kernel, dropout), supervised training with Adam; separate phases for direct and cascaded channel (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Synthetic Rayleigh channel gains for every antenna pair plus synthetic noise (channel SNR 20 or 30 dB) and receiver noise; no standard model or measurement (p. 4).
test_conditions: Fixed setup M=64, K=8, L=100; 70/30 split of generated data for training and testing; NMSE versus receiver SNR from -10 to 40 dB (p. 4).
baselines: LS (Fig. 4 legend); learned: MLP [38] and ChannelNet [17], a CNN estimator of direct and cascaded channels (pp. 1, 4).
metrics: Output NMSE of direct and cascaded channels versus receiver SNR; predicted NMSE as model uncertainty; training and prediction time (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Measured on a CPU: DGP training 13 min, prediction 3 ms; ChannelNet 20 min, 5 ms; MLP 6 min, 2 ms (Table III, p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "via a Rayleigh model to which a synthetic noise" is added, for every antenna pair (BS-LIS, LIS-user, BS-user). Custom Rayleigh simulator; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "70 percent of the total data is used for training, while the remaining 30% is used for testing". The test data come from the same generated set and the same setup (Table I: M=64, K=8, L=100, P=64); the SNR sweep of Fig. 4 does not count.
q3_support: p. 4: "we compare the proposed DGP with the multilayer perceptron (MLP) [38] and the ChannelNet framework [17]". The Fig. 4 legend on the same page also plots an LS curve; all are compared on NMSE versus SNR.
q4_support: p. 5: "The training and prediction times for the proposed and benchmark approaches are reported in Table III"; Table III gives 13 min training and 3 ms prediction for the DGP.
q5_support: p. 4: "a training dataset according to the system model in Section II" is generated synthetically. The paper states no code, no data link or DOI, and uses no public dataset.
notes: Research letter. The LS baseline appears only in the Fig. 4 legend (p. 4); the text names MLP and ChannelNet only, so q3 rests on MLP and ChannelNet being learned and on the LS curve being non-learned. The training receiver SNRs (10 to 30 dB, p. 4) are narrower than the Fig. 4 sweep (-10 to 40 dB), but that is an SNR sweep and does not count for q2. Tables I to III and Fig. 4 were read from the page images.
